title: Net Worth Source Lag by Institution
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:account
| stats latest(days_since_refresh) as days_since_refresh by institution
| where days_since_refresh>2
| sort - days_since_refresh
description: Uses Plaid account refresh metadata telemetry to monitor how stale each institution is inside net-worth rollups in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sources that are distorting current balance snapshots, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid account refresh metadata data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Institution table of refresh lag in days.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how stale each institution is inside net-worth rollups so you can spot sources that are distorting current balance snapshots before it becomes annoying.
